h1: Edge rounding and deslagging machines — radius to 5/64″, both sides in one pass, slag off plasma parts
intro: An edge rounding machine turns the sharp edges of laser-, plasma- and punch-cut parts into an even radius, so they are safe to handle and paint or powder coating covers the edge instead of thinning out on it; a deslagging machine takes the dross off the bottom edge of thick plasma and oxy-fuel parts. NovoTech sells three Gecam machines for this work, built in Parma, Italy: the G135RB8, whose carousel of eight counter-rotating abrasive brushes rounds every edge — inside holes too — to a 5/64″ (2 mm) radius across 53-1/8″; the GT06 and GT13, which run strip brushes on cross belts above and below the part and round both sides in one pass without touching the faces, 23-5/8″ and 51-3/16″ wide; and the G65DCC, which breaks the slag off parts 3/8″ to 4-3/4″ thick and rounds their edges. Supplied with a CSA-approved panel, installed and supported from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: Why round the edges of laser-cut parts?
faq.a: A laser or punch leaves a sharp, square edge that cuts hands and gloves and on which paint and powder coating pull thin — the edge is the first place a coated part rusts. A rounded edge is safe to handle and takes an even coat. The G135RB8 rounds edges to a 5/64″ (2 mm) radius; the GT06 and GT13 round the edges evenly on both sides at once.

The G135RB8 works the top of the part, with the deepest radius and a belt for heavy burrs. The GT06 and GT13 work the edges from above and below in the same pass, so parts are not turned over and fed twice, and they leave the faces untouched — the choice for galvanized, brushed or pre-painted sheet.

Removing the dross — re-solidified metal — that plasma and oxy-fuel cutting leave on the bottom edge of thick parts. Ground off by hand it takes minutes per part; the G65DCC presses an abrasive belt on a soft rubber roller against the edges, breaks the slag away and then rounds the edges with strip brushes, on parts 3/8″ to 4-3/4″ thick.

faq.q: Do the brushes mark coated or brushed sheet?
faq.a: The strip brushes of the GT06 and GT13 work the edges and leave the faces as they were, so galvanized, brushed and pre-painted surfaces are kept. The G135RB8 is also suitable for surface-treated material; set its belt group off when the face must not be touched.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
